description: A patient-completed questionnaire which assesses the degree of disability and quality of life in patients with low back pain.
instructions: Please answer every section. Mark ONE box in each section that most closely describes you TODAY.

sections.title: Low Back Disability Assessment
sections.description: Select one option for each section that best describes your current situation
